text:
QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (line 566) installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free` (or mutex-wrapped variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on) through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself via the setter, but never says it is the only in-tree user, and it doesn't name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C. It also says "Nothing in the library installs a different allocator per context", which is a different claim.
